summary: West Tek's 2055 establishment of biological research seeking cures for the New Plague.

displayName: Military Takeover of West Tek Research
summary: The 2071 transfer of West Tek's biological programme under United States military command.
The post-War split in which a faction left crowded Vault 15 with much of its best equipment.
An attack remembered uncertainly by Katrina that displaced survivors before 2161.
The pre-2161 establishment of Shady Sands by an unnamed ancestor of Aradesh.
The post-War expedition led by Richard Grey to investigate the source of mutations at Mariposa.
Grey's survival and progressive assimilation after falling into FEV at Mariposa, followed by his conception of Unity.
Nicole's pre-2161 formation of a peace-and-knowledge organisation after migration and violence.
The failed Brotherhood expedition to the Glow in which radiation and security systems killed members despite power armour.
Caleb's killing and Blades frame-up order after Josh attempted to expose the Regulators.
The disappearance of three caravans in one month through Unity capture and captive processing.
The purification-controller failure that threatens Vault 13 with dehydration and begins the Vault Dweller's journey.
The technical start boundary of Fallout: 5 December 2161 at 07:21, when the Vault Dweller begins the water-chip mission.
The player-era Khans abduction of Tandi and the method-variable effort to secure her release.
The player-dependent confrontation among Killian, Gizmo, Lars and the Vault Dweller over the assassination plot.
The variable-date successful-route return of a compatible water chip, resolving the immediate mechanical crisis.
The player-dependent removal of the Vault 12 chip and possible repair of the underground ghouls' pump.
The possible Boneyard uprising enabled by evidence of Josh's murder and Gun Runner support.

displayName: Destruction of the Boneyard Deathclaw Nest
summary: The player-dependent destruction of the reproducing nest blocking access to the Gun Runners.
The optional Lost Hills initiation in which the Vault Dweller is directed to retrieve evidence from the Glow.
The player-dependent council decision that can lead Brotherhood Paladins to assist against Unity targets.
Laura's player-era infiltration supplying evidence and access concerning the Children and Cathedral.
The successful-route neutralisation of Unity's super-mutant production capability at Mariposa.
The method-variable confrontation beneath the Cathedral, resolvable through persuasion, combat or a nuclear route.

displayName: Destruction of the Cathedral Command Centre
summary: The successful-route loss of the Master and Unity's Cathedral command centre.
The successful-route final expulsion of the returning Vault Dweller from Vault 13.
